household_message.text: Taking the car to work tomorrow, 8 to 5. Charge it to 90% from the solar panels at midday.

message_to_household: I’ve treated your work hours as an away period and your requested charge as 90% by 17:00, starting no earlier than 12:00. The plan can add 18.5 kWh from solar between 12:00 and 17:00, reaching about 86%, so it cannot meet the 90% target by then.

questions.text: You asked to charge the car from solar at midday, but you’ll be away from 08:00 to 17:00 and the car is currently plugged in. Will it remain plugged in and available for charging while you’re at work?

notes:
Read back (message sent Mon 21:00):
- car 90 % by Tue 17:00 (evening, in 20.0 h), not before Tue 12:00 (afternoon, in 15.0 h)
- away from Tue 08:00 (morning, in 11.0 h) to Tue 17:00 (evening, in 20.0 h)
warnings: the car cannot get the full 20.0 kWh by 07-26 17:00; the charger adds at most 18.5 kWh in that time, so the car will be at about 86 %. It charges at full power until then.
